name: NithyaPortfolio
description: Personal portfolio of Nithya Madalakote Prakash — AI Engineer building production-ready Generative AI, RAG, and ML systems. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.

paragraphs: Personal portfolio of an AI engineer (RAG, LLM agents, MLOps). The idea is evidence over adjectives: four flagship case studies, each with a demo GIF, three measured results taken from the project's own README, and an "honest limits" note, followed by other work, education, research and experience.
features: Case studies: Industrial AI Copilot, ClauseGuard, FleetOps and HybridRAG, then eight more projects with one headline metric each. Every number is copied from the project README it links to.

Ask my portfolio: a small RAG system that runs in the browser. It searches this site's own content with BM25, answers with quoted citations, and declines when the evidence is weak. No LLM, no server, nothing leaves the…
Details: English and German content, light and dark themes, a skills marquee, scroll reveals, a contact form, and a downloadable one-page resume (public/resume.pdf).
